title: MZ RPG Maker MZ deployment problem for mac

posts.author: sinjinse
posts.body:
Hello. I'm still new here so I'm trying to find my bearings. I've recently finished making a game and deployed it. The version for Windows works normally when my friend opens the game. My other friend who uses an M1 chip Mac, however, cannot open the game version that I deployed as Mac. They said that whey click on the "Game" file, there is an error message saying "The application "Game" can't be opened.
I tried to search online and there were different posts that tried to help. Like checking with the security approval of the Mac they are using, and downloading the updated NW.js from the website. (It is Arm64 ver 0.106.1 right now). But most of the threads I've read that tried to help was a different Arm64 version... so I'm not sure if it will create a problem or some steps are different. For one... the current deployed MacOS version of the game I have, when i looked into its contents, in the framework folder, there is no "Internet plugin" that exists, but in the help guide I saw, it was listing it as one of the files to replace.... but I'm not even sure what to replace it with.
Also, since I worked on this game using my Mac laptop, I tried to open it and seemed to open just fine. But maybe that's because this is the same
NW.js that comes with the RPGMaker MZ that I have? (I bought it from steam, if that makes it different?)
Thank you for reading this inquiry and help.
I'm adding a screenshot here of some important device logs that my friend checked when they tried and failed to run the game on their mac. I hope this helps.
